note:
REGENERATED 2026-10-05 after merging origin/main e3daeb739 (PR #588, LAY-01), by mission lane A. Previous note: "initial record: 24 synthetic scenarios ... at engine 2026.09.22-1, census-layover L241".

WHAT CHANGED ON THE 24 RECORDED SCENARIOS, measured order-insensitively field by field against the previous golden: ONLY inputHash and snapshotId, on all 24. No verdict, confidence, tier, return state, window rating, hard return, total buffer, usable minutes, shortfall, reason code, rule or input fact changed on any scenario.
CAUSE: #588 bumped LAYOVER_FEASIBILITY_VERSION "2026.09.14-1" -> "2026.10.04-1" (artifacts/api-server/src/services/airport/LayoverFeasibility.ts:84). feasibilityInputs puts that string into the named inputs (LayoverFeasibility.ts:362) and feasibilityInputHash hashes the inputs (LayoverFeasibility.ts:423); snapshotId is derived from inputHash. #588's new named inputs (constraints, policy) are absent for a legacy session, so nothing else in the hash moved.
CORRECT UNDER THE SPEC: yes. Same decisions, new identity for a new rules version is what L5 (versioned, replayable) asks for.

ADDED: six scenarios #588 made representable (the old UNREPRESENTED list named two of them as #588's).

| s26-checked-through (same, CHECKED_THROUGH) | tight, usable 68, no gate rule | App B.2 step 5: landside evaluated once confirmed | yes |
